Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 348.32 per unit (po:4500014474-10, po:4500014413-10, po:4500014350-20).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have incorporated your updated volume forecast into our calculation, which allows us to offer a reduced unit price. 

Our current offer is a price of €373.13 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. To provide you with this competitive rate, we must adjust the payment terms back to 30 days net, as 90 days would require a higher price. Alternatively, at our standard terms with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: a price of €369.02 per unit, no Preisgleitklausel.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €372.65 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

We acknowledge your firm commitment to an annual volume of 6,110 units, which we have incorporated into our calculation. To support a more competitive unit price, we must revert to our standard payment terms of 30 days net, as extended terms incur additional costs. Based on this volume and 30 days net, we can offer a revised price of €368.55 per unit, at our standard terms, with no Preisgleitklausel. 

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? 

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
